failures_and_resolutions.observation: GI exposes both Accessible.get_text and Text.get_text with different signatures; the initial native tree read selected the wrong bound method
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Use explicit Atspi.Text, Action and EditableText interface methods. All 25 final live native checks passed; initial failed receipt retained

failures_and_resolutions.observation: Codex's shared control socket was unavailable for supported MCP refresh
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Verified the registered server with a separate real Codex MCP client and discovered the local skill. No current-chat tool loading is inferred; use the shell fallback until the documented MCP Restart action

failures_and_resolutions.observation: Guest UTF-8 installation output triggered a Windows cp1252 decoder error in the original SSH capture path
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Explicit UTF-8 decoding with replacement for malformed bytes; real emoji-output regression passed. Missing browser was then established by guest state inspection rather than assumed installation success

failures_and_resolutions.observation: Playwright Node browser download timed out; Python HTTPS access to the same official CDN succeeded
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Downloaded only the installed registry's exact headless shell through guest Python with TLS validation; checked archive length, safe paths and local SHA256. Real browser/session tests passed
failures_and_resolutions.cause_certainty: Different transport outcomes observed; underlying Node downloader cause not established. TLS verification was preserved

failures_and_resolutions.observation: Bridge live test was started while the browser acceptance held the guest lock
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Operation rejected; bridge retested sequentially after the active job. Runtime transport failures return MCP tool errors; no automatic replay

failures_and_resolutions.observation: Cold-boot test assumed a removed heading on a public example page; title, multilingual text and ARIA were returned correctly
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Exact-content assertions remain in the owned local fixture; external HTTPS check asserts URL and nonempty title/text/ARIA. Corrected cold-boot check passed; failed receipt preserved

failures_and_resolutions.observation: Seed attached as SATA CD-ROM was not discovered by this minimal Ubuntu guest
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Preserved first disk; prepared new disk and attached CIDATA filesystem as read-only virtio block device
failures_and_resolutions.cause_certainty: Discovery fixed; missing SATA/CD driver was an inference, not independently proven

failures_and_resolutions.observation: PowerShell quoting encrypted the initial SSH key
failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Preserved encrypted original and removed the unintended passphrase; tested direct argument-list generation produces an unencrypted dedicated key
failures_and_resolutions.cause_certainty: Verified key cipher and successful authentication

failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Binary SSH script transfer; regression case and actual C build passed

failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Wait for only-visible guest window; verify typed command result and screenshot

failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Check Windows process exit state before identity query; clean shutdown passed
